group_theory.escape: Split multiplet thresholds using E6-breaking VEV, nonuniform soft masses compatible with gauge invariance, additional representations, or degree 5+ adjoint invariants; then calculate full F/D and one-loop operator.
group_theory.exact_complete_27_quartic_identity: 12 Tr27(H^4)=(Tr27(H^2))^2 for arbitrary six-variable E6 Cartan H
group_theory.no_go: Two COMPLETE E6 27+bar27 mirror messenger pairs, equal M/y/soft Delta across all 27 components, yield a quartic only in [Tr27 H²]^2. No directional 3+2 selection at this order.

not_UV_completion: The mirror-exchange invariant is concrete at the renormalizable E6 operator level; an exact full SUSY E6 vacuum, anomaly-free symmetry, split spectrum and proton lifetime are not established.

operator_symmetry.potential_Z4R_spurion_issue: S2 HuHd is allowed, so a charged spurion can reintroduce mu and other prohibited terms when its F/VEV breaks the symmetry.
operator_symmetry.proton_scope: The Z4R forbids local holomorphic dimension-five QQQL and UUDE BEFORE R-breaking. Gauge-boson dimension-six exchange is not forbidden; anomalies, nonperturbative R-breaking, triplet mixing and UV consistency require separate analysis.
